name: Tests

on: [push, pull_request]

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  CLICOLOR_FORCE: 1
  RUSTDOCFLAGS: "-Dwarnings"
  RUSTFLAGS: "-D warnings"

# Jobs run on the toolchain pinned in `rust-toolchain.toml`, except where one
# sets `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN` to override it (`check-minver`) or manages its own
# toolchain (`build-on-msrv`).
jobs:
  test-latest:
    name: Test on Latest
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - macos-latest
          - windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@nextest
      - name: Test
        run: make test

  test-current-cargo-insta:
    name: Run the in-tree version of cargo-insta on ourselves
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@nextest
      - name: Test
        run: cargo run -p cargo-insta -- test

  build-on-msrv:
    name: Check on MSRV
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # `cargo msrv` installs and checks the `rust-version` from Cargo.toml itself,
    # independent of `rust-toolchain.toml`.
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: baptiste0928/cargo-install@v3
        with:
          crate: cargo-msrv
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Verify minimum rust version
        run: make check-msrv

  test-latest-dependencies:
    name: Test latest deps
    # Note that we don't test MSRV after running `cargo update`, since that
    # would increase our maintenance burden — we'd need to be constantly pinning
    # sub-dependencies
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@nextest
      - run: cargo update
      - name: Test
        run: make test

  build-docs:
    name: Build docs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: doc
        run: cargo doc --all-features

  clippy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Run clippy
        run: make lint

  check-minver:
    name: Test with minimal version resolution
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    env:
      # `cargo minimal-versions` needs nightly for `-Z minimal-versions`. Pinned
      # because newer nightlies reject the `rustc_*` attributes used in `rustix
      # v0.36.4`, which it resolves to; bump once a newer nightly is known-good.
      RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: nightly-2026-04-25

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ env.RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN }}
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cargo-hack
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cargo-minimal-versions
      - name: Test
        run: make check-minver

  rustfmt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Run rustfmt
        run: make format-check

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
